name: agent-host-operations
title_zh: 共享主机上多智能体协作的安全操作守则
tagline_zh: 同一台机器上多个AI代理同时改代码，最怕互相踩踏。这套约定让每个代理都清楚何时该停、该问、该等，避免冲突和误操作。
tagline_en: Multiple AI agents editing code on one machine? This convention tells each when to pause, ask, and.
desc_en: Safe operating conventions for autonomous coding work on shared Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode agent hosts. Use when preparing, implementing, testing, reviewing, or publishing project changes on a multi-agent development host.
why_zh: 不是工具，是行为约定。它把人类团队的安全规范翻译成代理能理解的操作边界，让多代理协作从混乱走向有序。
why_en: Not a tool—a behavioral contract. Translates human team safety norms into agent-understandable boundaries, turning chaotic.
limit_zh: 仅适用于Claude Code、Codex和OpenCode三种宿主环境。不包含代码审查逻辑，不处理版本控制冲突。
limit_en: Only for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode hosts. No code review logic, no merge conflict handling, no command implementations. Beyond that, extend.
title_en: Safe operating rules for multi-agent coding on shared hosts
